history.summary: Very large freehold 3BR (1,765sqft) at $1,467 PSF in D23, but 1.29km / 15-min walk from the new Hume MRT and built 1997 (~29yr). Low PSF is partly a function of an oversized floorplate, not genuine value, and the appreciation rate rests on a thin 9-txn series.
history.rating_rationale: The headline 7.1%/yr CAGR is unreliable on only 9 transactions, and the $1,467 PSF looks cheap mainly because 1,765sqft is oversized — total quantum is $2.59M, above the liquid sweet spot for an aging OCR 3BR. Hume MRT now exists (a plus) but at 1.29km it adds little. Freehold and space are real positives, but weak walkability, age and thin liquidity keep this Neutral.
catalysts: New Hume MRT (DTL) opened in the precinct
Large layout appeals to space-seeking families
